# VeltraUI Documentation & Architecture Reference
> Ultra-lightweight, Enterprise-grade Admin UI Suite built with pure Tailwind CSS v4 and Vanilla TypeScript.

## Architecture Rules for AI Agents
1. Pure Tailwind CSS v4 (@import "tailwindcss"; native, zero tailwind.config.js, zero legacy preprocessors).
2. Pure Lucide Icons (<i data-lucide="..."></i> only; no FontAwesome, no Flaticon).
3. Anti-FOUC Dark Mode script in the <head> of every document.
4. CSS Custom Properties prefixed with --vlt-* for colors, layout dimensions, and typography.
5. Component structure namespaced with .vlt-* classes (.vlt-card, .vlt-sidebar, .vlt-nav, .vlt-modal).
6. Multi-framework ready: Works out-of-the-box in HTML, Laravel Blade (<x-ui.*>), React, Next.js, Vue, and Angular.
